name: Integrated circuit
description: A paint with an animated pattern that serves as an aesthetic coating for your tank. Its color scheme might potentially offer some camouflage benefits, but besides that, the paint does not offer any functional gameplay advantages.
interestingFacts: This paint was added to the game on March 26th, 2021.
This paint could only be obtained from ultra containers for a limited time.
The paint returned to ultra containers on April 23, 2021.
Some say this paint makes their computers run faster, while others say it just makes art students run away. In any case, it's a unique-looking paint.
The paint was added to containers on January 14th, 2022.
